fact: Law 05-20 on cybersecurity, promulgated by dahir of 25 July 2020 and published in the Bulletin officiel of 6 August 2020, requires entities to classify their information assets (art. 5) and states that sensitive data must be hosted exclusively on national territory (art. 11).
title: Dahir n° 1-20-69 du 4 hija 1441 (25 juillet 2020) portant promulgation de la loi n° 05-20 relative à la cybersécurité
publisher: Bulletin officiel du Royaume du Maroc n° 6906
